soslar.name: Sauces
soslar.description: Pauwels bucket and bottle sauces (Andalouse, Samurai, Cocktail, Curry, Mayo Chef), Bicky, sambal, Tabasco and halal bolognese. Essential for chip shops (frituur) and döner counters.

et-urunleri.name: Meat & Döner
et-urunleri.description: Döner spits from Maximus, Dost, Düzgün, Polat and Efendi; chicken, beef and turkey; halal meatballs, salami and pepperoni. Cold chain guaranteed.

dondurulmus.name: Frozen
dondurulmus.description: Lutosa and Sela chips, snacks from Van Reusel, Mekkafood and Dunya, croquettes, seafood and desserts.

konserve.name: Canned & Pickles
konserve.description: Peeled tomatoes, pizza sauce, jalapeños, Greek peppers, artichoke, tuna, anchovies, capers and pickles. The basic canned goods for pizza and döner.

peynir-sut.name: Cheese & Dairy
peynir-sut.description: Grated and block mozzarella, gouda, gorgonzola, Gazi feta, parmesan and cream. The complete range for pizzerias.

ekmek-hamur.name: Bread & Dough
ekmek-hamur.description: Fırat döner pide, gobit bread, lahmacun bases, durum wraps and tortillas, pizza dough balls from Foster and Piazzola.

kuru-gida.name: Dry Goods & Spices
kuru-gida.description: Flour from Caputo and Primo, Barilla pasta, pulses and rice from Hane and Nawras, spices, frying oil and olive oil, tea and sugar.

icecekler.name: Drinks
icecekler.description: Coca-Cola, Pepsi, Fanta, Lipton, Looza, Capri-Sun, Uludağ, Kızılay, Çamlıca, ayran, şalgam, energy drinks, water, beer and Kavaklıdere wines.

ambalaj.name: Packaging
ambalaj.description: Pizza boxes, chip and frikandel trays, döner, menu and burger boxes, aluminium trays, carrier bags, wrapping paper, cutlery and napkins.

hijyen.name: Hygiene & Kitchen
hijyen.description: Nitrile gloves, hand soap, glass and grill cleaner, disinfectant, toilet paper, bin bags and kitchen equipment such as döner knives.
